entities.name: Julia Müller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Julia Müller is a German field hockey national team player who competed in the 2008 Summer Olympics and the 2012 Summer Olympics. In August 2019, she was inducted into the European Hockey Federation Hall of Fame.
